Named for Stacy

Stacy and Mary Sanders took over this diner in 1969, and Mary kept the grill going for more than fifty years. In 2026 she handed the keys to Theresa, who waited tables here for years, and the menu stayed just the way you like it.

The building is a Valentine diner, one of the small steel diners built in Wichita and shipped to towns all over the plains. There's been a diner on this spot since 1954, a minute off I‑70 at Grandview Plaza.

Mornings start with the regulars. By nine the travelers find us, and the counter fills with soldiers, truckers and families on the road.

Sit where you like, order what you like, and if you can't decide, ask about the biscuits and gravy.
